narrative.overview: Experience mode puts the sneaker rotation at the center of the page. A saturated, changing stage fills the space between dark gallery chrome; white product copy and a lightly tinted panel keep the selected colorway readable.
keyCharacteristics: Alpha-transparent sneakers orbit a cropped off-screen axis.
Stage color, artwork, content, and selection change together.

rules.body: Change the stage background and selected swatch with the product content. Keep the header and footer dark across all six states.
rules.name: The Synchronized Color Rule

dos: Do preserve six colorway pairings and synchronized content.
Do maintain shoe proportions with counterrotation and inverse vertical scaling.
Do retain stacked mobile layout, keyboard navigation, and reduced motion.
donts: Do not substitute placeholder glyphs for sneaker artwork.
Do not add the reference video editor panels.
